query: How many build-up sequences do we have for Arsenal?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sequence_count, MIN(s.id) AS sequence_id FROM sequences s JOIN possessions p ON p.match_id=s.match_id AND p.possession_id=s.possession_id JOIN teams t ON t.id=p.team_id WHERE t.name ILIKE '%Arsenal%' AND s.tag='build-up'
